programmes.t: Jackie Fabulous: Menoplause
programmes.d: Jackie Fabulous muses on finding herself living back in the Bronx during a standup comedy performance at the 2021 Tribeca Festival.

programmes.t: Jenny McCarthy's Dirty Sexy Funny
programmes.d: Female comedians Paula Bel, Tiffany Haddish, Lynne Koplitz, Justine Marino and Tammy Pescatelli join Jenny McCarthy to shed some light on what it's really like to be a woman.

programmes.t: Katrina Davis: Figuring It Out
programmes.d: Comic and writer Katrina Davis attempts to process the world around her through Southern observations, drug-related sports facts and a theory on why dying alone makes perfect sense.

programmes.t: Kevin Hart Presents: Lil Rel Howery: RELevent
programmes.d: Comic Lil Rel Howery explains how he found out that his father wasn't a doctor; the difference between raising a son and a daughter; racism within the black community.

programmes.t: Kevin Hart Presents: Plastic Cup Boyz
programmes.d: Stand-up comics Joey Wells, Will Horton and Na'im Lynn make up the Plastic Cup Boyz, who have opened for Kevin Hart for many years, but now they step into the spotlight with headlining sets of their own.

programmes.t: Bill Engvall: Here's Your Sign: It's Finally Time: My Last Show
programmes.d: Bill Engvall, renowned comedian, entertains audiences for the last time.

programmes.t: Jim Gaffigan: The Pale Tourist - Canadian American
programmes.d: Jim Gaffigan performs in Canada and has some very strong opinions on poutine, Saskatchewan, health care and the pronunciation of the city of Regina.

programmes.t: Gabriel Iglesias: I'm Not Fat... I'm Fluffy
programmes.d: The comic known for wearing his signature Hawaiian shirts covers everything from his fondness for Paul Rodriguez to his own "fluffiness."

programmes.t: Lavell Crawford I Could Eat Part 2
programmes.d: Meat's on the menu with Lavell Crawford keeping Burger King humble to their have it your way slogan, godless vegetarians, and why the best chicken is from a house of God.

programmes.t: Harland Williams: A Force of Nature
programmes.d: Harland Williams performs in the Mojave Desert.

programmes.t: Craig Shoemaker: Daditude
programmes.d: A hilarious look at the transition that happens from manhood to fatherhood.

programmes.t: Kevin Nealon: Whelmed but Not Overly
programmes.d: The comic performs in Denver; topics include the fears, insecurities and doubts of parenthood.

programmes.t: Joel McHale: Live From Pyongyang
programmes.d: Joel McHale discusses feeding alligators in the south and wanting to name the San Francisco 49er's to something else.

programmes.t: Anjelah Johnson: The Homecoming Show
programmes.d: Stand-up comedian Anjelah Johnson returns to San Jose, Calif., for a special performance.

programmes.t: Alonzo Bodden: Who's Paying Attention?
programmes.d: The comic discusses the decline of civilization, the rise of pop culture, and swine flu.

programmes.t: Alonzo Bodden: Tall, Dark and Funny
programmes.d: The comedian performs.

programmes.t: Bob Saget: That's What I'm Talkin' About
programmes.d: Bob Saget takes to the stage with a filthy song in his heart as he lets loose and embraces the dark side as he tells his favorite dirty jokes and stories about his dad - the guy who made him like this.

programmes.t: Bob Saget: Zero to Sixty
programmes.d: Bob Saget declares himself to be the last TV father viewers can trust in his hour of entertaining stories, riffing with the audience, words of wisdom and new original comedy songs.

programmes.t: Danny Martinello: Starting Sober
programmes.d: Danny Martinello's debut special dedicated to those who had his back when he decided to put down the bottle.

programmes.t: Jeff Shaw: Manly Girly Man
programmes.d: Jeff Shaw entertains with his stimulating satire.

programmes.t: Jesus Trejo: Stay at Home Son
programmes.d: Mexican-American comic Jesus Trejo explores his upbringing as an only child to immigrant parents; he recalls learning many of life's lessons in the most unconventional ways, all the while feeling the need to meet his parents' high expectations.

programmes.t: Kevin Smith: Silent But Deadly Extended Edition
programmes.d: Kevin Smith is anything but quiet in this new comedy special that was recorded an hour before his heart attack in February; before he nearly died backstage, onstage he discusses his marriage, his kid and his work (or lack thereof).

programmes.t: Leanne Morgan: So Yummy
programmes.d: Leanne Morgan gives an honest look at suburban life and the challenges of keeping her husband happy while juggling kids, dogs, and cheerleading camp.
